newsitem.title: USA: Inflation fight shouldn't be sole Fed goal-Rivlin.
newsitem.headline: Inflation fight shouldn't be sole Fed goal-Rivlin.

text.p: Reducing inflation should not be the sole objective of the Federal Reserve, Fed vice chair Alice Rivlin said Friday.

"The Federal Reserve, as I said, should be focussed on sustainable growth. Inflation is one of the things that threatens sustainable growth but I think the rather vague words of the Humphrey-Hawkins Act are just fine," Rivlin told a Future Issues Forum in Raleigh, North Carolina.

She had been asked if she supported a proposal by Senator Connie Mack of Florida to make fighting inflation the Fed's sole mandate. Humphrey-Hawkins has a twin mandate of price stability and job creation.
"The reduction of inflation should not be the sole objective of the Federal Reserve," Rivlin said.
